title: Revise a letterhead whose pictures sit in the page header
brief: Keep the logo at the left of the header with the divider full-width beneath it, set the header distance to zero, keep the body empty, keep the page number.
judge: The header holds the logo at the left with the divider beneath it at the full text width, the header sits at distance zero from the top edge, the body is empty and the footer still shows the page number. Moic's failure was the pictures being lost (image_unknown) and an empty document saved.
